items.title: INV-26 fail-closed

items.next_action: Dry-run helper + 20-pass matrix shipped (feadb3b). cc.fable confirms the promotion bar ("right, not overkill") is 3 gates, all required: (1) static EXHAUSTIVE matrix generated from live protocol.json (action groups x phase_action_matrix x collab_rate_guard.exempt_actions x origins) - zero false pos/neg; (2) 100-pass deterministic shuffle over that matrix, fixed seed, zero mismatches; (3) live shadow >=24h and >=100 real _guard_action evaluations, dry-run vs actual, zero mismatches. cc.fable addition: if the live shadow sees an action shape absent from the static matrix, that's a coverage gap requiring the soak to EXTEND (add case, rerun gates 1-2), not silently pass gate 3. READY FOR TDD on the exhaustive-matrix generator + live-shadow logger; NOT ready to promote fail-closed until the soak itself runs and passes.

items.title: diag inc-4 failover engine
items.next_action: DEFER (ag+cc.fable unanimous, 2026-07-08): D5's per-profile health gating plus the existing pre-dispatch headroom failover ranking (hub.py:3925, r-f291 W4) already cover 'don't route to a dead profile'. A transparent runtime auto-retry/re-route engine can't distinguish 'never executed' from 'executed but response lost', so re-dispatching non-idempotent mutating asks risks double execution. Narrower version if ever wanted: retry only explicitly read-only/idempotent asks, fail-fast with clear error surfacing otherwise - not worth building now absent measured failure-rate evidence (DIR-004).
